# Initialize simulation frame counter s

step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

while vis.Run() :

    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data

        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()

    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)

```python
import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import pychrono.irrlicht as chronoirr

# =============================================================================
# Initialize the PyChrono System
# =============================================================================

# Create the physical system
system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()
system.Set_G_acc(chrono.ChVectorD(0, -9.81, 0))  # Set gravity

# =============================================================================
# Create and Initialize the HMMWV Vehicle
# =============================================================================

# Create the HMMWV vehicle model (Full version with all subsystems)
vehicle = veh.HMMWV_Full(system)

# Set initial position and orientation
init_pos = chrono.ChCoordsysD(
    chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 1),  # Position (x, y, z)
    chrono.QUNIT              # Orientation (identity quaternion)
)
vehicle.SetInitPosition(init_pos)

# Configure vehicle subsystems
vehicle.SetPowertrainType(veh.PowertrainModelType_SHAFTS)  # Use shaft-based powertrain
vehicle.SetDriveType(veh.DrivelineTypeWV_AWD)              # All-wheel drive
vehicle.SetTireType(veh.TireModelType_TMEASY)              # Use TMeasy tire model
vehicle.SetMaxEngineRPM(3000)                              # Set engine RPM limit

# Set visualization types for vehicle components
vehicle.SetChassisVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_MESH)
vehicle.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_PRIMITIVES)
vehicle.SetSteeringVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_PRIMITIVES)
vehicle.SetWheelVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_MESH)
vehicle.SetTireVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_MESH)

# Finalize vehicle initialization
vehicle.Initialize()

# =============================================================================
# Create and Initialize the SCM Deformable Terrain
# =============================================================================

# Create the SCM (Soil Contact Model) deformable terrain
terrain = veh.SCMDeformableTerrain(system)

# Set the base plane of the terrain
terrain.SetPlane(chrono.ChCoordsysD(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT))

# Set soil parameters (Bekker and Janosi-Hanamoto models)
terrain.SetSoilParameters(
    2e6,    # Kphi - shear modulus
    0,      # Kc - cohesion
    1.1,    # n - shear exponent
    0.01,   # Ks - settling coefficient
    30,     # phi - internal friction angle (degrees)
    0.8     # mu - friction coefficient
)

# Load a height map for terrain elevation (replace with your own image if needed)
terrain.SetHeightMap(chrono.GetChronoDataFile("terrain/heightmaps/hm_quad_01.png"))

# Finalize terrain initialization
terrain.Initialize()

# =============================================================================
# Create and Initialize the Driver System
# =============================================================================

# Create an interactive Irrlicht-based driver
driver = veh.ChIrrGuiDriver(vehicle)

# Set sensitivity for steering, throttle, and braking
driver.SetSteeringDelta(0.05)
driver.SetThrottleDelta(0.05)
driver.SetBrakingDelta(0.05)

# Initialize the driver
driver.Initialize()

# =============================================================================
# Set Up Irrlicht Visualization
# =============================================================================

# Create the Irrlicht application for visualization
application = chronoirr.ChIrrApp(
    vehicle,
    "HMMWV on SCM Deformable Terrain",
    chronoirr.dimension2du(1024, 768)
)

# Add typical lighting and camera
application.AddTypicalLights()
application.AddCamera(
    chronoirr.vector3df(0, 3, -6),  # Camera position
    chronoirr.vector3df(0, 0, 0)    # Target point
)

# Bind and update all assets
application.AssetBindAll()
application.AssetUpdateAll()

# =============================================================================
# Simulation Loop
# =============================================================================

# Set simulation time step
step_size = 0.01
time = 0.0

# Run the simulation loop
while application.GetDevice().run():
    # Synchronize components
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver.GetInputs())
    terrain.Synchronize(time)

    # Advance components
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)

    # Update visualization
    application.BeginScene()
    application.DrawAll()
    application.EndScene()

    # Advance the system dynamics
    system.DoStepDynamics(step_size)

    # Update simulation time
    time += step_size
```

- **Soil Parameters**: Adjust `SetSoilParameters()` values to simulate different soil types (e.g., sand, mud, clay).
- **Driver Control**: Use arrow keys or WASD for vehicle control in the Irrlicht window.

```python
terrainWidth = 100.0   # size in Y direction

# Track point for camera
trackPoint = chrono.ChVector3d(0.0, 0.0, 1.71)

# Contact method
contact_method = chrono.ChContactMethod_SMC
contact_vis = False

# Simulation step sizes
step_size = 1e-3
tire_step_size = step_size

# Render frame rate
render_step_size = 1.0 / 50  # 50 FPS

# Create the HMMWV vehicle
vehicle = veh.HMMWV_Full()
vehicle.SetContactMethod(contact_method)
vehicle.SetChassisCollisionType(chassis_collision_type)
vehicle.SetChassisFixed(False)
vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysd(initLoc, initRot))
vehicle.SetTireType(tire_model)
vehicle.SetTireStepSize(tire_step_size)
vehicle.Initialize()

vehicle.SetChassisVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSteeringVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetWheelVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetTireVisualizationType(vis_type)

vehicle.GetSystem().SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)

# Create SCM deformable terrain
terrain = veh.SCMTerrain(vehicle.GetSystem())
terrain.SetSoilParameters(2e6, 0, 1.1, 0, 30, 0.01, 2e8, 3e4)
terrain.AddMovingPatch(vehicle.GetChassisBody(), chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), chrono.ChVector3d(5, 3, 1))
terrain.SetPlotType(veh.SCMTerrain.PLOT_SINKAGE, 0, 0.1)
terrain.Initialize(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/height_maps/bump64.bmp"), 40, 40, -1, 1, 0.02)
terrain.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/dirt.jpg"), 6.0, 6.0)

# Create vehicle visualization
vis = veh.ChWheeledVehicleVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.SetWindowTitle('HMMWV Demo')
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 1024)
vis.SetChaseCamera(trackPoint, 6.0, 0.5)
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))
vis.AddLightDirectional()
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AttachVehicle(vehicle.GetVehicle())

# Create driver system
driver = veh.ChInteractiveDriverIRR(vis)
steering_time = 1.0
throttle_time = 1.0
braking_time = 0.3
driver.SetSteeringDelta(render_step_size / steering_time)
driver.SetThrottleDelta(render_step_size / throttle_time)
driver.SetBrakingDelta(render_step_size / braking_time)
driver.Initialize()

# Add random obstacles
for i in range(5):
    obstacle = chrono.ChBody()
    obstacle.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3d(np.random.uniform(-40, 40), 
                                     np.random.uniform(-40, 40), 
                                     0.5))
    obstacle.SetBodyFixed(True)
    obstacle.SetCollide(True)
    
    # Collision geometry
    obstacle.GetCollisionModel().AddBox(chrono.ChContactMaterialDefault(), 
                                       1, 1, 1, 
                                       chrono.ChFrameOffset(chrono.ChVector3d(0,0,0)))
    
    # Visualization
    box_shape = chrono.ChBoxShape()
    box_shape.GetBoxGeometry().Size = chrono.ChVector3d(1,1,1)
    obstacle.AddVisualShape(box_shape)
    
    vehicle.GetSystem().AddBody(obstacle)

# Create sensor manager and lidar
manager = sens.ChSensorManager(vehicle.GetSystem())

lidar = sens.ChLidarSensor(
    vehicle.GetChassisBody(),  # body to attach to
    10,  # update rate in Hz
    chrono.ChFrameOffset(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 2)),  # position offset
    360,  # horizontal samples
    1,    # vertical samples
    chrono.CH_C_PI,  # horizontal FOV
    0.01,  # vertical FOV
    100   # max distance
)
lidar.SetName("Lidar Sensor")
lidar.SetLag(0)
lidar.SetCollectionWindow(0.01)
lidar.PushFilter(sens.ChFilterVisualizePointCloud(360, 1, "Lidar Visualization"))
manager.AddSensor(lidar)

# Simulation loop setup
print("VEHICLE MASS: ", vehicle.GetVehicle().GetMass())
render_steps = math.ceil(render_step_size / step_size)
realtime_timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()
step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

while vis.Run():
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()

    if step_number % render_steps == 0:
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Synchronize modules
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    # Advance modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)
    
    # Update sensor manager
    manager.Update()  # Added sensor manager update

    step_number += 1
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)
```
